title: "02. Changes in measures over time"
date: 2026-03-14

```{python}
# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}
```

## End reason proportions per quarter

```{python}
# Generate Table
t1_1_data = dpw_rt_ends.copy()
t1_1_data = t1_1_data[t1_1_data["pl_end_dt"].notna()]
t1_1_data["rt_end_yr"] = t1_1_data["pl_end_dt"].dt.year.astype("Int64")
t1_1_data["rt_end_qtr"] = t1_1_data["pl_end_dt"].dt.quarter.astype("Int64")
t1_1 = t1_1_data[["rt_end_yr", "rt_end_qtr", "rt_end_cat"]].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("").unstack("rt_end_cat")
t1_1 = pd.concat([t1_1], keys=["End reasons"], axis=1)
t1_1.insert(loc=0, column=("n", ""), value=t1_1.sum(axis=1))
t1_1["End reasons"] = 100 * t1_1["End reasons"].div(t1_1["n"], axis=0)
t1_1 = t1_1.rename(columns={"End reasons": "End reasons %"})

excel_output["Table 1.1: Route end reasons per quarter"] = t1_1
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 3):
    display(t1_1)
```

### But 2025 Q2 had 28% errors / missing data and 2025 Q4 should not have an exit as it was way after the period

So `pl_end_dt` was set to `<NA>` for all dates > `distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt` (end of studied period).

Remaining errors relate to:
```{python}
errors_2025 = t1_1_data.loc[(t1_1_data["rt_end_yr"] == 2025)
                            & (t1_1_data["rt_end_qtr"] > 0)
                            & (t1_1_data["rt_end_cat"] == "Missing data/error"),
                            "pl_end_reason"]
display(errors_2025.astype("string").value_counts())
qcols = ['svc_type_short_padded', 'pathway_level', 'svc_id', 'gap', 'pl_start_dt', 'pl_end_dt', 'dur',
         'pl_end_reason', 'ref_agency']
dpw_pls[dpw_pls.route_id.isin(t1_1_data.loc[errors_2025.index, "route_id"])].set_index(["o_cli_id", "route_id"])[qcols]
```

## End reason proportions per year

```{python}
# Generate Table
t1_2_data = dpw_rt_ends.copy()
t1_2_data = t1_2_data[t1_2_data["pl_end_dt"].notna()]
t1_2_data["rt_end_yr"] = t1_2_data["pl_end_dt"].dt.year.astype("Int64")
t1_2 = t1_2_data[["rt_end_yr", "rt_end_cat"]].value_counts(dropna=False).rename("").unstack("rt_end_cat")
t1_2 = pd.concat([t1_2], keys=["End reasons"], axis=1)
t1_2.insert(loc=0, column=("n", ""), value=t1_2.sum(axis=1))
t1_2["End reasons"] = 100 * t1_2["End reasons"].div(t1_2["n"], axis=0)
t1_2 = t1_2.rename(columns={"End reasons": "End reasons %"})

excel_output["Table 1.2: Route end reasons per year"] = t1_2
with pd.option_context("display.precision", 3):
    display(t1_2)
```

## Tables in an Excel file

```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
sheetname = "Sheet1"
qmdfile = os.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE")
filename = assets_output + qmdfile[:-4]+".xlsx"
with pd.ExcelWriter(filename) as writer:
    next_row = 0
    for k, v in excel_output.items():
        pd.DataFrame([k]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, header=False, index=False, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += 1
        v.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, startrow=next_row, float_format="%.1f")
        next_row += (
            (1 if not isinstance(v.columns, pd.MultiIndex) else 1 + len(v.columns.levels))
            + len(v) + 1)
print(f"[Excel file](./{filename})")
```
